findings.evidence: `Mathlib/RepresentationTheory/FDRep.lean:130` proves `@[simp] theorem of_ρ' ... (ρ) : (of ρ).ρ = ρ := rfl`; the new lemmas have precisely these instantiated conclusions.
findings.fix: Delete both lemmas and use `FDRep.of_ρ' (stdRep k n)` and `FDRep.of_ρ' (stdDualRep k n)` directly; it is already tagged `[simp]`.
findings.issue: `stdFDRep_rho` and `stdDualFDRep_rho` (line 97) are exact specializations of Mathlib’s existing `FDRep.of_ρ'`.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Units/Hom.lean:120` provides `Units.coeHom_injective`; `Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin` is a `MulEquiv` at `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/GeneralLinearGroup/Defs.lean:103`, hence already injective.
findings.fix: Replace the matrix-extensionality proof with a `simpa [stdRep]` application of `Units.coeHom_injective.comp Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.toLin.injective`.
findings.issue: `stdRep_injective` manually reconstructs injectivity of a composition whose two factors already have generic injectivity proofs.

summary: Two new projection lemmas directly duplicate Mathlib’s existing `FDRep.of_ρ'`; the faithfulness proof also rederives generic injectivity lemmas.
